description:
One research page: every claim with the first run's and the second run's numbers (each run a
    sample of different channels), n per run and per cell, shown_a and shown_b (over the sample
    bar), reproduced (true, false, or null for too few) and direction, plus measures naming what
    each number is computed from. 404 page_not_found for an unknown slug, 422 for a malformed one.
    No key needed; limited per address. Free. Same as GET /v1/findings/{slug}.
name: get_research
